question: On one fresh Duskblade Vow-5 policy rectangle, does the frozen six-damage Scoreline payoff improve whole-run quality beyond the identical Oath-plus-Executioner assignment, while the full commitment has a positive total effect, policy-sensitive viable witnesses, bounded duration, zero reliability regression and no Afterimage leakage?

identityGate.authority: One three-arm Scoreline component CRN panel only.

scorelinePayoff.definition: The admitted exact Chisel mark and later exact Executioner consume path; payoff is one separate raw-damage operation.

scorelineCommitment.definition: The admitted existing-representation assignment of one research Oath and one existing base Executioner deck copy.

afterimagePayoff.status: Fixed outside the design and absent.

frozenFactors.separation: Scoreline payoff and commitment are separate causal factors. Afterimage does not vary and no cross-package cell is present.

assignment-only.meaning: Identical Oath and Executioner assignment with zero Scoreline damage.

full.meaning: The exact admitted commitment plus frozen six-damage Scoreline path.

design.type: three-arm mechanism-blocked common-random-number discovery panel; not a full factorial
design.sharedIdentities: All cells use the same root-559 policy vectors, four simulation seeds, Duskblade Vow-5 baseline, candidate executable, content, estimator and stopping rule.
design.primaryContrast: Full minus assignment-only. Both cells have byte-identical initial assignment, deck size, uid and assignment RNG; the frozen Scoreline payoff is their only configured difference.
design.totalContrast: Full minus base estimates the complete commitment package under its natural current shuffle, draw, combat and economy consequences.
design.assignmentContrast: Assignment-only minus base is reported to expose generic existing-card movement but cannot admit Scoreline by itself.
design.interaction: Full minus assignment-only is also the payoff-by-commitment difference-in-differences because payoff-six/no-Oath aliases base exactly by the 265-row identity gate.
design.rng: Every cell starts from the same simulation-seed identity. Assignment-only and full begin with the same deck and RNG path; later divergence caused by realised Scoreline damage is mediated treatment behaviour. Full versus base may consume current shuffle RNG differently only because the intended assignment changes deck size.
design.policy: Frozen BalancePolicy identity and current BalancePilot scoring in all cells. No policy weight, timing control, random mode or online adaptation is added.
mechanisticallyJustifiedInteractions: Payoff by commitment is necessary because the payoff is Oath-gated and the assignment-only cell isolates the added-card main effect.
design.aliasStructure: Payoff-six/no-Oath equals base exactly and is omitted. Three cells therefore identify total, assignment and payoff-at-assignment effects without spending a fourth Cartesian arm.
design.omittedCells: No Afterimage, payoff level sweep, additional commitment, rarity, acquisition scalar, policy-priority, RandomBuild, Ash, held-out, ML, RL, optimiser or protected-seed cell is authorised.

cohort.disjointness: Root 559 and all four seeds are absent from every closed identity, capacity and causal cohort and from protected acceptance and reserve ranges.

estimands.unit: Policy identity. The four matched simulation-seed differences are averaged within each policy before inference.
estimands.quality: Win indicator plus terminal HP divided by terminal maximum HP.
estimands.primary: Cluster-mean full-minus-assignment-only quality and Scoreline payoff-event effects.
estimands.assignmentMainEffect: Cluster-mean assignment-only-minus-base quality effect, reported but never sufficient for admission.
estimands.secondary: Paired win, HP fraction, mean turns per completed fight, producer events, Executioner plays and Chisel plays for all three frozen contrasts.
estimands.activation: A policy is active when at least two of four full-cell seeds have one or more exact Scoreline payoff events.
estimands.viability: An active policy with at least one full-cell seed that both wins and records an exact Scoreline payoff.
estimands.policySensitivity: Counts of policy-cluster full-minus-assignment-only quality values greater than zero, equal to zero and below zero; positive viable and non-positive sets are the gates.
estimands.reliability: Exact stall/error rows, policy mismatches, Oath retention, Scoreline progression/value, card-path and Afterimage-isolation faults.
estimands.notEstimated: RandomBuild/global-power movement, Ash aspect separation, independent replication, cross-package functional separation, detector score, candidate selection, product balance or protected confirmation.

estimators.point: Unweighted arithmetic mean of 64 within-policy four-seed CRN means.
estimators.interval: Percentile bootstrap over the 64 frozen policy-cluster values with 5,000 resamples.
estimators.stopping: One fixed complete-rectangle first look; no sequential peeking, extension, cohort replacement or endpoint addition.

gates.telemetry: Base and assignment-only emit zero Scoreline event; full has exact producer-set and consumer-consume-payoff equality, requested six per payoff, bounded realised damage and an exact Chisel/Executioner path for every payoff row.
gates.assignment: Base has no Oath; assignment-only and full retain exactly one Oath in every terminal row.
gates.factorIsolation: Every cell emits zero Afterimage event.
gates.policyIdentity: All three policy snapshots are equal for every policy-seed identity.
gates.reliability: Zero stall/error rows in the complete rectangle.
gates.effect: The lower 95% policy-cluster bounds for full-minus-base quality, full-minus-assignment-only quality and full-minus-assignment-only payoff events must all exceed zero.
gates.sensitivity: At least eight policies are both viable and have positive payoff quality contribution, while at least sixteen have zero or negative contribution. This detects exploitability without requiring failed activation from a deterministic commitment designed to solve reachability.
gates.duration: The upper 95% bounds of both full-minus-base and full-minus-assignment-only mean combat-turn changes are at most 0.25 turns per fight.
gates.vow5: Full-cell win rate is at most 0.90.
gates.provenance: The 16 active, eight viable/positive, sixteen non-positive, 0.25-turn and 0.90 Vow-5 limits reuse the current 64-policy package-support and commercial guardrail scale; no observed endpoint informed them.

executionAndStopping.construction: Deterministic Python constructs all three complete cells, runs one Godot process, content-addresses plan/output, fits only the frozen cluster bootstrap, appends all 768 observations atomically and applies stop/go.
order: Verify component identity success, task capsule, repository and archive refs, source hashes, Godot and ledger freeze.
Verify assignment, telemetry, value, card-path, factor-isolation, policy and reliability identities.
Fit the three declared contrasts and frozen endpoints only.
Atomically append the complete rectangle and apply exactly one disposition.
executionAndStopping.successStop: Stop at boundary 1 only when every exact, support, sensitivity, effect, activation, duration, reliability and Vow-5 gate passes.
executionAndStopping.futilityStop: Stop at boundary 2 for any fixed exact/count/guardrail failure, any required effect upper bound at or below zero, or a duration lower bound above 0.25.
executionAndStopping.inconclusiveStop: Stop at boundary 3 for an immutable, execution, schema, row, ledger or wall fault, or when no fixed failure exists but a required effect or duration interval straddles its boundary.

decisionRules.success: All preregistered checks pass at the sole complete look.
decisionRules.successAuthority: Apply boundary 1: freeze at most the exact full Scoreline commitment for one independently preregistered held-out confirmation on fresh policy and research seeds with RandomBuild, Ash aspect, reachability, duration and reliability evidence. Do not tune payoff or assignment and do not use protected seeds.
decisionRules.futility: Any fixed failure rule is met at the complete look.
decisionRules.futilityAuthority: Apply boundary 2: close the exact Scoreline commitment family without rescue and continue with the next evidence-backed structural mechanism inside #421. Do not tune payoff, card count, policy or Oath; add a joint cell; or use ML, RL, an optimiser or protected seeds.
decisionRules.inconclusive: Execution cannot produce a decision, or an otherwise admissible effect or duration interval straddles its boundary at the cap.
decisionRules.inconclusiveAuthority: Apply boundary 3: record at cap; do not rerun, extend, replace cohorts, add a cell or method, or use protected seeds.
